blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Zone Authority (Tieza) on Monday sought a transition period before travel taxes are abolished, saying the levy funds the majority of tourism-related infrastructure. Tieza Chief Operating Officer Mark Lapid made the request during the Department of Tourism’s budget hearing before the Senate finance subcommittee. “Regarding the issue of travel tax, definitely we will be deeply affected because 94 percent to 95 percent of our operation is coming from travel tax… We humbly request that maybe we can first have a transition period for the travel tax,” Lapid told the panel.
